# Reach and selection: all cells (generated by scripts/mechanism_tables.py; descriptive)

Definitions as in the paper. *Reached*: a correct answer appears among the answers. *Selected*: the most frequent answer is correct. The first answer (T=0) is shared by all loops of a cell. Independent samples: samples 1-9. Tokens: millions, solver and critic.
